objective: Compute a joint active/reactive dispatch for an islanded microgrid with a diesel unit and grid-forming inverter.

title.en: REL-TASK-022 — Joint active/reactive dispatch in an islanded microgrid
title.ru: REL-TASK-022 — Совместная диспетчеризация P/Q в изолированной микросети

objective.en: Balance active and reactive demand while respecting inverter apparent-power capability and maintaining voltage limits.
objective.ru: Сбалансировать активную и реактивную нагрузку с учётом полной мощности инвертора и допустимых напряжений.

instructions.en: Use islanded_pq_case. Choose a joint P/Q dispatch for the diesel unit and the grid-forming inverter. Constraints: p_diesel + p_inverter = load.p_mw and q_diesel + q_inverter = load.q_mvar; diesel within pmin/pmax and qmin/qmax; 0 <= p_inverter <= p_available_mw; p_inverter^2 + q_inverter^2 <= s_rating_mva^2. Voltage model (use exactly this): voltage_pu = base_voltage_pu + sensitivity_pu_per_mvar * (q_diesel + q_inverter); it must stay within vmin_pu/vmax_pu. Cost = p_diesel * variable_cost_per_h + |q_diesel - q_preferred_mvar| * q_deviation_penalty_per_mvar_h. Report dispatch, voltage_pu, and total_cost. Any feasible dispatch is admissible: minimum-cost dispatch scores 1.0, feasible but costlier dispatch receives partial credit by cost gap.
instructions.ru: Используйте islanded_pq_case. Выберите совместное P/Q-распределение между дизелем и сетеобразующим инвертором. Ограничения: p_diesel + p_inverter = load.p_mw и q_diesel + q_inverter = load.q_mvar; дизель в pmin/pmax и qmin/qmax; 0 <= p_inverter <= p_available_mw; p_inverter^2 + q_inverter^2 <= s_rating_mva^2. Модель напряжения (используйте ровно её): voltage_pu = base_voltage_pu + sensitivity_pu_per_mvar * (q_diesel + q_inverter); напряжение в пределах vmin_pu/vmax_pu. Стоимость = p_diesel * variable_cost_per_h + |q_diesel - q_preferred_mvar| * q_deviation_penalty_per_mvar_h. Укажите dispatch, voltage_pu и total_cost. Принимается любое допустимое распределение: минимальная стоимость даёт 1.0, допустимое но более дорогое — частичный балл по разрыву стоимости.

submission_schema.dispatch: object with diesel and inverter P/Q values
submission_schema.total_cost: diesel active cost plus reactive deviation penalty

hard_constraints: Submitted dispatch must satisfy P/Q balance, diesel limits, inverter availability and apparent-power capability, and voltage limits, as re-checked by the evaluator.
voltage_pu and total_cost must be consistent with the submitted dispatch.
Any feasible dispatch is admissible: equal-cost optima receive full score; suboptimal feasible dispatch receives partial credit by cost gap.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted dispatch satisfies all balance, limit, capability, and voltage constraints and is internally consistent.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: 1.0 at the optimal cost; otherwise max(0, 1 - cost_gap/optimal_cost).

metrics.name: cost_gap
metrics.description: Achieved cost minus the optimal cost.
